title: Normalized class comparison over an arbitrary scheme
statement: For any commutative coefficient ring A in universe u+1, any scheme T in universe u, any A-module sheaf F on its small etale site and any natural degree q, the specified normalized class map ordinaryFiniteClass A T F q [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class] is bijective. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1: ordinary module/abelian cohomology comparison needed to identify normalized Chern representatives

proof.text: The constants/global-sections adjunction identifies maps from the constant free rank-one module sheaf with sections, by evaluation at one. The specified integral generator corepresents exactly this identification; hence the normalized comparison is bijective in degree zero.

An injective module sheaf has acyclic underlying abelian sheaf for global sections, on every scheme. Transport right-derived global sections to evaluation at the terminal etale object and then to sheaf cohomology.

Embed F in an injective, take its cokernel, and compare the two long exact sequences using the Ext comparison naturality. By induction and the right-exact-sequence comparison lemma the next degree is bijective. Compose with the Ext/derived-morphism equivalence.
